runner.tagline: Rides Trend & Breakout's index trades (not momentum continuation, which lost on the replay): same entry, the stop left alone until +3 R, then trailed 3 R behind the best price. PAPER shadows the real trade; LIVE holds its own position beside it.

bandbreaker.label: Band Breaker
bandbreaker.tagline: Intraday index momentum: a band of normal noise around the open; a half-hour close outside it is the trade; stop at the far band or VWAP; flat before the close.
bandbreaker.rule: average noise of the last 14 sessions; checks every 30 min from 10:00; at most 3 entries a day per market; 10 at the stop

crowd.label: Crowd Fader
crowd.tagline: Positioning from Coinversa: when the losing crowd is stretched one way and the proven winners are not with them, lean the other way once the price turns; stop beyond the last hour, target the nearest liquidation cluster.
crowd.rule: crowd 50% net one way and the winners not with them; score 60+; entry on a 15-min close beyond the last 8; stop beyond the last 4 bars; target the nearest cluster or 2 R; out after 24 h; at most 2 a day per market; 10 at the stop (the smallest size up to 30); reads every 10 min

EUR/CAD broke above the edge of where it had been stuck and was moving fast, so the bot bought it. But the move did not carry on - it turned back - so the bot got out quickly. It closed at -5.7 pips (-£6.77).

USD/JPY broke out of its range from the first minutes of the session, so the bot bought it. But the move did not carry on - it turned back - so the bot got out quickly. It closed at -2.5 pips (-£3.67).

USD/CAD broke out of the range it had kept to earlier in the day, so the bot bought it. It moved far enough for the bot to move the safety stop up behind it (it never moves it back). When the price came back to the stop, the trade closed at +0.9 pips (-£0.13).
CAD/JPY broke out of the range it had kept to earlier in the day, so the bot sold it. But the move did not carry on - it turned back - so the bot got out quickly. It closed at -2.4 pips (-£3.57).

CAD/CHF broke through a level, came back to touch it once, then moved away again, so the bot sold it. It kept going fast, so the bot let it run and kept moving the safety stop behind the price (it never moves it back). When the price came back to the stop, the trade closed at +4.7 pips (+£4.11).

EUR/CAD poked past an old low, then snapped straight back, so the bot bought it. It kept going fast, so the bot let it run and kept moving the safety stop behind the price (it never moves it back). When the price came back to the stop, the trade closed at +14.8 pips (+£13.85).

GBP/CAD was rising strongly, paused for a moment, then started rising again, so the bot bought it. It kept going fast, so the bot let it run and kept moving the safety stop behind the price (it never moves it back). When the price came back to the stop, the trade closed at +16.9 pips (+£15.96).
